_about: The ontology's identity: its release rises on every published change, `extends` names what it composes on top of, `carries` what the directory holds.
name: work
summary: What is planned, by whom, blocked by what, deployed where: work items and milestones over the product's requirements, features and components; three states derived from appended transitions; what slips when a component is late, what is overdue, what waits on whom.

changelog.note: Leaves the engine (ADR-0010): the work commands (oto work set, board, notify, inbox, reply, event, remind) and the board in the status snapshot travel as the module oto_work in the ontology's code/, loaded through provides; the SessionStart hook that opens a session with the inbox comes with the pack. The vocabulary is release 6's, unchanged. Needs OTO 0.14.7; from 0.14.8 the engine ships no work of its own.
Milestone.state is a decision (default planned): a phase is reached when a named person says so with `oto decide`, the assertion kept on the node (found closing phase 5 of the OTO roadmap).
`governs` widened to work items: the decisions that shaped an epic are one question away; `decided_by` widened to a Person.
Milestone.date is optional: a roadmap's phases are ordered before they are dated (found tracking the OTO roadmap).
Transition.event: the event that caused a change (a merged pull request), recorded once however often it is delivered; `oto work event merged-pr` appends it.

Three states (roadmap M1-M3): open, blocked, deployed, derived from appended Transition facts; a Block carries its reason and whom it waits on; Person; deployed_to per environment; WK11-WK13. planned and in-progress read as open, done as deployed; a dropped item is retired. `oto work set` appends a transition.
First release: work items and milestones on the product's requirements, features and components; the delivery lead's questions WK1-WK10, confirmed by Chiheb Dkhil on 2026-10-07.
